description: Comptage des véhicules sur l'axe routier rue Désoyer/rue d'Alger is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commune de Saint-Germain-en-Laye. These data were produced from a camera located at the intersection of rue Désoyer and rue d’Algiers, in the commune of Saint-Germain-en-Laye. The camera continuously recorded the passage of vehicles over 4 zones (entry/exit). It also determined the type of vehicle according to legal administrative standards (Bicycle, Motorcycle, Light or Heavy Vehicle). Coverage: Commune de Saint-Germain-en-Laye. The portal shows the English title as "Counting of vehicles on the road axis rue Désoyer/rue d’Algiers" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Commune de Saint-Germain-en-Laye. Its keywords include voirie, circulation. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, PDF. The listing shows 2021-02-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
